checks: Every iteration matches an independently sorted expected result.
Null payloads are not decoded into cache; cached validity is copied with admitted storage.
All iterations end with zero reservations.
findings: Cached medians were lower in 35 of 36 scenarios in this run, with wide-text top-3/nulls-first slightly slower.
Timing winners differ from earlier runs, so no production threshold is inferred.
At width 1024 and 10000 rows, nullable cache uses about 18.3 MB versus roughly 5 KB direct workspace.
limitations: One ASCII key column; dictionaries, multiple keys, Unicode payloads and cross-job reuse remain unmeasured.
Sequential Node kernel timings, not cloud/Worker runtime bounds.
